Title: Few questions about LotN cards, LSJ?

Messages.Author: Klai...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
When does Shemti have to be untapped for his special to trigger? Is it
when the action is announced, or when the action resolves?

If you block someone and play Hard Case to cancel the combat, is your
blocking vampire still tapped for succesfully blocking?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Klai...@gmail.com wrote:
> When does Shemti have to be untapped for his special to trigger? Is it
> when the action is announced, or when the action resolves?

Card text. "untapped" "successfully performing"

> If you block someone and play Hard Case to cancel the combat, is your
> blocking vampire still tapped for succesfully blocking?

Yes. Successful block -> tap the blocker.

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
On Oct 11, 12:56 pm, LSJ <vtes...@white-wolf.com> wrote:

> Klaita...@gmail.com wrote:
> > When does Shemti have to be untapped for his special to trigger? Is it
> > when the action is announced, or when the action resolves?
>
> Card text. "untapped" "successfully performing"

Shemti
Clan: Follower of Set (group 5)
Capacity: 9
Disciplines: OBF POT PRE SER vic
Independent: Shemti has 1 vote (titled). While he is ready and
untapped, any minion successfully performing a (D) action against you
takes 1 damage (after resolving the action)

Does this then mean he has to be untapped from the beginning till the
resolution of the action?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Only when a minion is "successfully performing" the action.
An action is only successfully performed (or not) at resolution.
